_readme: Teachers who publish lessons through pull requests (docs/handoff/teacher-publishing.md). Only the owner edits this file, on main. handle = the <name> in the teacher's branch names teacher/<name>/...; github = his GitHub account (the check refuses a pull request opened by any other account); subjects = the folders he may change; auto_merge = false: the owner approves every pull request, true: it merges by itself once every check is green.
